text:
[LTAC.5.4] If multiple timers' `fire_at` fall in the same tick,
the engine must fire all of them in that tick. Their follow-up
activations complete together, on that tick ([LTAC.5.1]), and are
ordered as any activations are: those of different rules by
[LDET.5.4], and those of one rule by the order [LDET.5.5] gives
matches that complete together.

---

idris.name: ltac_5_4__inputs
idris.note: THE INPUTS: two timers with `fire_at` 2 and 3, then one tick to 5. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__ready
idris.note: THE NETWORK AS THE INPUTS LEFT IT: the tick to 5 has made both matches. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_counts
idris.note: Counted per pump: nothing at either assertion, two at the tick, `[0, 0, 2]`. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_ready
idris.note: BOTH DUE ON ONE TICK: two activations, one per timer, unfired, in the order matches that complete together take. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_trace
idris.note: BOTH FIRE IN THAT TICK: `[0, 0]`, each firing retracting its own timer, nothing live after. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__armed_timed
idris.note: THE STATE TWO TRIGGERS LEAVE after one pump: both timers armed, stamped 0, the first-asserted trigger's first. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_timed
idris.note: TWO TIMERS DUE IN ONE TICK BOTH FIRE IN IT, THE EARLIER-MINTED FIRST: from the armed state the advance to 4 and a pump fire the follow-up twice, the timer minted for the first trigger before the one for the second -- [LDET.5.5]'s order on matches that complete together, logical/LTAC.5.4_same_tick_order's shape -- each firing retracting its own timer, and the triggers alone remain. Executed.
